title: Avis de grève des contrôleurs aériens SYNACCI prévu à partir du 19 janvier
reason: SYNACCI lifted the planned notice on 11 January after talks with the transport minister, before the planned start; no execution is reported. A work stoppage notice alone is not evidence of a qualifying public gathering.
notes: Abidjan.net reproduces a notice with a year typo (19 January 2022) in an article dated 9 January 2023; the withdrawal report explicitly specifies the intended 19 January 2023. This excludes the canceled announced action only.
